szoveg_eredeti:
Natalie Breymeyer / Axios :

 Collective, which uses AI to automate bookkeeping for solo business owners, raised a $40M Series B and $60M in nondilutive capital from GC's Customer Value Fund   —  Collective, a financial services platform for solo business owners, secured $100 million in financing, CEO Hooman Radfar tells Axios.
